about: A made-up 6-step episode of cx-rules-only that crosses all three rules. Each step lists the propositions that are true; the script runs it through the real runtime and checks it against the reward layer.
notes: picks the key up, the door is closed: the promise opens
drops the key, the door is still closed: the soft rule breaks
picks the key up again: the promise stays open
opens the door: the promise is kept
picks up the target box: the hard rule breaks, the episode ends
